children.name: Isognomon alatus
children.description: Isognomon alatus, the flat tree oyster, is a species of bivalve mollusc in the family Isognomonidae.

children.name: Isognomon californicus
children.description: Isognomon californicus, the black purse shell or nahawele in Hawaiian, is a species of bivalve in the family Isognomonidae.

children.name: Isognomon perna
children.description: Isognomon perna, the brown purse shell or rayed tree oyster, is a bivalve in the family Isognomonidae common in the Indo-Pacific including Hawaii.

children.name: Isognomon radiatus
children.description: Isognomon radiatus, the radial purse oyster or Lister's tree oyster, is a species of bivalve mollusc in the family Isognomonidae.

children.name: Isognomon valvanoi Rossi de Garcia & Levy, 1977
Bathyisognomon smithwickensis Hickman, 2023
children.description: The hinge line is slightly arcuate and there is no distinct posterior wing or auricle. The beaks are produced, forming a narrowly acute angle (40 – 50 °). There is a sharp anterior byssal indentation beneath the beaks followed by a nearly straight anterior shell margin. The posterior and ventral margins are evenly rounded posterior to the hinge line. The ratio of height to length = 0.7.
